difficulty_reason: After ordinary finite-chain,conditional-probability and stationarity inputs, the author uses the global minimum density to determine desired stopped mass at every time/state,subtracts previously stopped mass to design adaptive state-time hazards,and implements them with independent uniforms while preserving the joint-mass invariant. This simultaneous filling construction attains the separation tail for all times and is the concrete H2 mechanism; optimal SST existence itself is not treated as free background.
